title: Masu Gine-ginen Dutse
intro: Ka yi tunanin wata babbar wayewa, mai baiwa da ƙarfi da fasaha, tana sassaka manyan gidaje a gefen tsaunuka. Wannan ƙungiya tana da wadata mai yawa da kuma ƙwarewar gine-gine ta musamman. Duk da haka, duk da samun gargaɗi bayyanannu, sun zaɓi hanyar da za ta kai ga ƙarshe mai ban mamaki da ba za a manta da shi ba. Za ka iya gane wannan ƙungiyar wadda labarinta ya zama darasi mai zurfi ga duk wanda ya yi tunani?
clues: An ba mu ƙarfi da ƙwarewa, wanda hakan ya ba mu damar sassaka gidaje masu kyau kai tsaye a kan tsaunuka.
An ba mu wata alama bayyananna daga Allah, wata halitta ta musamman da za a bar ta ba tare da wata damuwa ba don kiwo.
Al'ummarmu ta zama masu girman kai, suna ƙalubalantar saƙon Allah da wani manzo daga cikinmu ya kawo.
Mun yi makirci don cutar da alamar mu'ujiza, duk da gargadin azaba mai tsanani.
Mun ƙi bin umarnin da aka bayar na barin wannan halitta ta musamman ta sha daga rijiyarmu a wasu ranaku daban-daban.
Mun gamu da mummunan ƙarshe, an buge mu da wani irin bugu mai ban tsoro bayan mun aikata laifinmu.

outcome.label: Sakamakonmu na Ƙarshe
options: An ba shi dukiya da iko mai yawa
An ɗaukaka shi zuwa ga annabci
An warwatse a duniya don yawo

arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
